guidance.metric_label: Growth of 40-45% this year, consolidated and standalone
guidance.condition: Asked whether on consolidated or standalone: 'both'. Next year's guidance at the end of this financial year
guidance.quote: Somewhere in between 40% to 45% is the continued growth that we will continue to demonstrate, in this financial year onwards.
guidance.speaker: A. Krishna Sai Kumar (Whole-time Director, Operations)

guidance.quote: we are not giving EBITDA guidance anytime, sir.
guidance.speaker: A. Krishna Sai Kumar (Whole-time Director, Operations)

guidance.metric_label: Order book of ₹3,500-4,000 Cr by end of FY27
guidance.condition: Needs a single order of ₹2,500-3,000 Cr (MIGM); order book was ₹1,704 Cr (₹1,224 Cr standalone, ₹480 Cr Ideal) on 8 Aug
guidance.quote: by end of this financial year, we are expecting a single order more than INR2,500 crores, INR3,000 crores, which will cumulatively bring, could bring our order book to INR3,500 crores to INR4,000-odd crores is on a consolidated basis.
guidance.speaker: A. Krishna Sai Kumar (Whole-time Director, Operations)

guidance.metric_label: MIGM purchase order by December or January
guidance.condition: Total budget about ₹3,500 Cr, 20% advance, Apollo expects about 70% of the order, over about 3 years
guidance.quote: Like order, we are expecting by December or January, we are expecting the purchase order.
guidance.speaker: Karunakar Reddy Baddam (MD)

guidance.condition: First phase already in production; a new plan only after the whole facility is operating
guidance.quote: Maybe the final production as a complete production activity, I think before March '27, we are going to start.
guidance.speaker: Karunakar Reddy Baddam (MD)

insights.summary: Q1 FY27 consolidated revenue was ₹251 Cr (+88% YoY), EBITDA ₹54 Cr (+31%) and PAT ₹25 Cr (+43%); standalone revenue was ₹156 Cr (+17%) and PAT ₹28 Cr (18% margin). The consolidated order book was ₹1,704 Cr, of which Ideal Explosives ₹480 Cr. Management held 40-45% growth guidance for the year, gave no EBITDA guidance, and expected the MIGM purchase order (about ₹3,500 Cr, 20% advance) by December or January.

what_changed.text: Growth guidance of 40-45% for the year, consolidated and standalone
MIGM purchase order expected December or January

tone.label: steady
tone.quote: Given the long procurement cycles and milestone-based execution of defence contracts, revenue recognition can be uneven across quarters.

analyst_questions.answer: 40-45% growth on both bases; 'we are not giving EBITDA guidance anytime'.
₹1,700 Cr now; a single order of ₹2,500-3,000 Cr by year-end could take it to ₹3,500-4,000 Cr; no comment on Premier during CCI review.

red_flags.text: Standalone growth was only 17% in Q1 against 40-45% guided, so the year depends on large orders landing.
Management says quarterly figures can be uneven because of long procurement cycles and milestone-based recognition.

watch_next: Q2 standalone growth against the 40-45% guide
